verdict.rationale: INPI publishes plain-language, second-person explainers aimed at non-lawyers. Examples include "if you developed a new and inventive technical solution, you can file a patent application", a provisional patent described as a "simple, easy and accessible" option, and sequencing guidance like "the next step is conversion to a definitive application". It also offers a dedicated "Guide to online application for trademarks and logos" and covers renewals, oppositions and withdrawals the same way. Missing for 10: evidence of full step-by-step walkthroughs beyond snippet-level explainers and the guide's title, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that founders can actually follow the guidance.
